g12-economics-ue1-t1.overview: Definition and Focus Areas of Macroeconomics sits inside Fundamental Concepts of Macroeconomics. The fundamental concepts of macroeconomics are the focus of Unit 1 of Grade 12 Economics in the Ethiopian (FDRE Ministry of Education) curriculum. First, it revisits the definition and focus areas of the subject. Then it examines the key challenges: economic growth, inflation, unemployment, the business cycle, and the balance of trade. Finally, it traces the main schools of thought, from the classical view to the new Keynesian. Students will also learn how the fundamental concepts of macroeconomics explain real-life policy debates.
objectives: Define macroeconomics and describe its focus areas.
Explain growth, inflation, unemployment, and the business cycle.
Compare the classical, Keynesian, monetarist, and new schools of thought.
Relate the fundamental concepts of macroeconomics to policy debates.
g12-economics-ue1-t1.simple:
Definition and Focus Areas of Macroeconomics in plain words. The exam wants you to recognise the core ideas, not to memorise whole paragraphs. Focus on:
  • First, macroeconomics as the study of the economy as a whole.
  • Also its focus areas, from national output to the general price level.
g12-economics-ue1-t1.detailed:
Definition and Focus Areas of Macroeconomics — the essentials. First, macroeconomics as the study of the economy as a whole. Also its focus areas, from national output to the general price level.

What the MoE expects you to be able to do:

  • Define macroeconomics and describe its focus areas.
  • Explain growth, inflation, unemployment, and the business cycle.
  • Describe the balance of trade.
  • Compare the classical, Keynesian, monetarist, and new schools of thought.
  • Relate the fundamental concepts of macroeconomics to policy debates.
